requestedIntent: Owner decision 2026-10-27: one machine-wide observation log for every ACEF host, with a defined write threshold, read points, a version stamp so readers skip unchanged logs, a weekly digest and rule files with cost, review date and activation; plus a session-start check that tells a host its ACEF installation is behind.

docs: CHANGELOG.md#v3.0.0-beta.4 — Central feedback log and version checks (2026-10-27)

limitations: Wired, not enforced: nothing blocks a coordinator that skips the intake search, the review-brief check or the closeout move of ACEF-gözlem lines; the templates and the global agent instructions ask for them.
The store is machine-local (~/CODE/acef-feedback, its own git repository without a remote); agents on another machine cannot write to it.
Imported legacy logs are free text: search matches them by keywords only, and their entries have no tags or costs.
Effect not measured yet: the first digest should report how many entries were written, how many searches surfaced a used lesson, and repeat counts.

evidence.note: 2026-10-27: 24 checks passed (format, closed tags, pipe escaping, cross-project similar list, repeat/status, search ranking and limit, promoted entries hidden, due, digest, legacy numbering and search, 8 parallel appends with unique ids, version/check stamps).
